notes: One member also serves as a voting member of the foundation board. Pay and time commitment are not stated on the page.
name: Youth Council
what_you_do: Help give out more than $100,000 a year in grants to local youth projects, take part in service projects, and go to a statewide summer grantmaking conference.
who_can_apply: High school students who live in Washtenaw County. Ages and grades are not stated on the page. The page does not say where the council meets.
deadline_text: The page says the new member application is closed until 2027. No dates posted yet.
how_to_apply: Application not open. Watch the Youth Council page in 2027. Contact: Community Investment Officer at (734) 663-0401 x116.
